messages:
sasha: Heads-up — planning a dedicated capacity change tonight to reduce cold-starts for the cobalt reserved pool. Target window: 22:00-22:30 UTC. Will bump min_burst from 2 -> 5 and enable short burst smoothing for 30m.

sasha: Reason: observed tail latencies at peak; this should keep a warm slice without overshooting commit. Config path: infra/gpu/pools/cobalt/autoscale.yaml (PR ready).

anya: I can own smoke checks. What do you want me to validate?

sasha: Thanks. Smoke checklist:
- quick gen against model-prod-small (50 reqs) latency < 120ms p95
- token throughput sanity (no >15% error increase)
- console: no new 5xx spikes, KV cache miss rate stable
- verify rollout didn't flip routing to fallback models

mike: I'll watch the SLO dashboard and the cost-ops meters, plus logs for evictions. Ping me 5m before apply.

taylor: I'll be on standby for rollback if we see allocator pressure. What is the rollback plan?

sasha: Rollback plan: revert autoscale.yaml to current commit (sha: d4c3f2a) and reapply: 
```
git checkout d4c3f2a -- infra/gpu/pools/cobalt/autoscale.yaml
kubectl apply -f infra/gpu/pools/cobalt/autoscale.yaml --context=k8s-prod
```
If kubectl reapply isn't sufficient, we'll trigger the infra rollback playbook: infra/plays/rollback_reserved_pool.sh --pool=cobalt and notify infra oncall.

anya: Copy that. I'll run the gen tests from my laptop (+post results here). Can we get a quick smoke run in staging first (21:40 UTC)?

sasha: Yes, staging smoke at 21:40. Prod at 22:00 if staging looks good.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window recorded: cobalt min_burst bump. ETA 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z. Reminder will go out 15m before.

mike: heads-up — I've added a temporary grafana panel for cobalt slice pressures and the allocator free GPU counter. I'll watch and alert if free GPUs < 2 for > 60s.

taylor: One more question — will this change adjust slice spread? Could increase co-location risk.

sasha: Good call. Change only touches min_burst + smoothing; allocator spread settings unchanged. Still, watch host_fail_rate and eviction_queue.

anya: Staging smoke at 21:40: all green. Latencies slightly improved; no error spike. Posting raw numbers: p50 45ms, p95 98ms, errors +0.2% (within noise).

sasha: Thanks. Proceeding with prod at 22:00. I'll apply PR and post deploy command output here.

[22:00:12] sasha: Applying autoscale update now — `terraform apply -target=module.cobalt_autoscale -auto-approve`

[22:00:40] deploy-bot: Terraform apply completed for module.cobalt_autoscale (plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy).

[22:01:05] anya: Running gen smoke: 50 requests against model-prod-small. p95 92ms, no 5xx, throughput stable.

[22:02:10] mike: Watching dashboards — allocator free GPUs dipped to 1 for ~30s at 22:01 but recovered to 3. No sustained pressure. No extra evictions.

[22:03:00] taylor: No allocator alerts for evictions. Host_fail_rate unchanged.

sasha: Great. Leave the change in for now. We'll reassess after the 30m smoothing window. If anything degrades, follow rollback steps above and ping infra oncall.

anya: One note — I'll post a short runbook snippet in ops playbooks: ops/playbooks/cobalt-minburst-smoke.md with the checks I ran.

sasha: Thanks everyone. Closing out here unless anyone sees anything odd in the next 15m. :thumbsup:
